name: org_scope_evolution
description: Versioned SCOPE registry and member-governed declarative overlays. Actor is the real executor. Read snapshot/context/get_patch/get_scope; register_patch/register_scope use {spec,expected_revision,request_id}; propose uses {bindings:[{patch_ref:{patch_id,revision},scope_ref:{scope_id,revision}}],expected_revision,evidence:[refs]}; each actual member approve {proposal_id,note}; leader deploy {proposal_id}. execute {patch_ref,input,idempotency_key} invokes vetted operations only and returns allowed/output/effect. withdraw {deployment_id,reason}; revalidate {deployment_id}; review {deployment_id,subject,tool,arguments,evidence}; export_transfer {}; validate_transfer {pack}. No caller-supplied actor/model/team/context or arbitrary code execution. Transfer never imports approvals.

name: org_organize
description: When the human requests organization collaboration, choose native SubAgents or desktop chats. Native start data: {runtime:native_subagents,name,task,new_members?:2,execution_mode?:native}. Persists only the actual root; the root then calls collaboration.spawn_agent within host limits. Each actual child joins using start data {runtime:native_subagents,join_org:org_id} with its own request_id; host ancestry and canonical paths are verified. Native creation and join are atomic, and native messages return collaboration routes. No desktop chats or model runtime are created in native mode. Desktop start data: {name,task,new_members?:2,include_current?:true,members?:[existing chat IDs],leader?,project_id?,governance?,execution_mode?:quiet,delivery_mode?:after_turn}. Defaults to current chat as leader and separate workspaces for new members. Members decide roles/interfaces. Human authorization is required; a peer message alone does not authorize new chats. Fresh request_id for a new organization; reuse the exact request after uncertainty, never invent a new key to retry. status reads its receipt with data:{}. Returns created_threads and org_id. Unknown host outcomes remain uncertain without blind retries.

name: org_benchmark
description: Develop and evaluate mutually dependent components with host acceptance, or drive the complete connected OrganizationBench tool catalog. Local operations list/status/brief/submit/evaluate/release use data.run_id; submit {component,content,expected_revision}, release {bundle_hash}. Upstream operations catalog/events/invoke/upstream_status/export use the human-connected session; invoke {bench_actor?,tool,arguments,request_id}. Gate names are org_benchmark_release for exact {run_id,bundle_hash}, and bench_<upstream tool> for upstream arguments. Fresh request_id for each new operation; reuse after uncertainty. Actor always comes from this chat executor identity.

name: org_discover
description: List local Codex sessions available to the human for organization membership. Does not enroll or message anyone.

name: org_panel
description: Open a standalone native desktop window to select chats, choose a leader, start/pause an organization and inspect shared work. No browser tab is needed.

name: org_context
description: Read the current executor's authorized organization snapshot, messages, episodes, protocols and shared documents. Native mode additionally returns canonical member paths, the actual recipient inbox and pending native outbox routes. No side effects.

name: org_message
description: Send persistent messages to selected members; quiet organizations batch them for background continuation of the same Codex sessions. Read execution_mode in org_context. Native mode returns native_outbox with concrete collaboration.send_message/followup_task arguments; execute those routes with the actual host tools. Routes stay pending until the actual recipient acknowledges. The server never sends native routes through the desktop bridge. No per-message desktop wake in quiet mode. Delivery states distinguish pending, sent, uncertain and acknowledged. Fresh idempotency_key for each new message; reuse the same key after uncertainty. Operations: send {body,recipients?:[thread_id],idempotency_key,reply_to?,episode_id?,delivery_mode?:after_turn|immediate}; ack {message_id}; dispatch {} (only your own pending messages); configure {delivery_mode} (leader only). immediate offers peer input at the next trusted tool boundary in the current turn; an offered context is not acknowledgment.

name: org_work
description: Maintain shared organization work. Operations: document_write {key,body,expected_revision}; task_update {title?,task_id?,owner?,status?,evidence?,expected_revision?}; episode_open {title,participants?}; episode_close {episode_id,outcome:success|failure|partial|cancelled|observed,summary,evidence:[str]}; episode_reflect {episode_id,body}. Completion needs outcome evidence; reflections feed protocol proposals.

name: org_protocol
description: Record weak and strong organizational protocols; both are protocols. propose {episode_id,title,rationale,strength:weak|strong,supersedes?}. Weak adds {guidance,trigger,scope,evidence:[refs]} with no blocking rules; may arise in an open participant episode, or after personal reflection on a closed one. agree {protocol_id,body} records ONLY your own agreement; a weak proposal activates when leader plus the configured quorum agree, without separate vote/adopt calls. Strong (legacy default) adds rules:[{tools:[glob],effect:deny|require_peer_review,input_contains?:[str],argument_equals?:object,members?:[id],reason?:str}] and requires a closed reflected episode, comment {protocol_id,body}, vote {protocol_id,vote:approve|reject,reason}, then leader adopt {protocol_id}. retire {protocol_id,reason}. record_use {protocol_id,version,idempotency_key,work_unit,outcome:followed|deviated|inapplicable,note,evidence:[refs]} records your actual use, not a plan; it is member-reported evidence, not automatic enforcement. Reuse the exact key after uncertainty. Revisions are new immutable proposals via supersedes. Weak protocols guide coordination and never block tools; only strong protocols install gates. No mandatory protocol count.

name: org_review
description: Check an exact tool call against active rules, or attest to a different member's exact pending call. operation check uses {tool,arguments,subject?}; record uses {protocol_id,subject,tool,arguments,evidence:[str]}. Review expires after one hour and is bound to the active protocol version and complete arguments.

name: org_call
description: Start a persistent text meeting and wake selected member chats to discuss one agenda. Participants retain their own workspaces. Returns episode_id. Replies use org_message with that episode_id; owner closes with outcome evidence. This is text communication, not realtime audio.
